violation_type.title: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines - Except if Less Than 4 Feet, 12 Inches or Less Above Resilient Material (26 TAC §744.3105(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines - Except if Less Than 4 Feet, 12 Inches or Less Above Resilient Material
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found  non-compliant.    It was discovered that a child was on a trampoline that was more than 4 feet in diameter and more than 12 inches off the ground.

finding_variants.text: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found  non-compliant.    It was discovered that a child was on a trampoline that was more than 4 feet in diameter and more than 12 inches off the ground.
Based on information gathered during the investigation, it was determined that a child in care was injured on a trampoline during an off-site field trip.
